assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a production thumbnail image for a BI dashboard theme selector.
Use the attached gallery ONLY as reference for screenshot-like miniature dashboard composition and density. Generate ONE standalone full dashboard screenshot, not a gallery, not a theme selector. Landscape 16:9 image, perfectly front-on flat UI, edge-to-edge, no device, no browser chrome, no perspective, no outer margin.
All four theme assets in this series must use this same composition: thin header across top with a tiny Chinese title “经营数据看板” and small filter controls; a compact row of four metric summaries; middle row with a large smooth multi-series filled area chart on the left (about 55% width) and a grouped multicolor vertical bar chart on the right; bottom row with a narrow tidy data table on the left, a small line chart in the center, and a donut chart on the right. Thin grid lines, tiny unobtrusive Chinese axis labels, crisp readable graph silhouettes even at 140px thumbnail width. Modern professional enterprise BI styling, carefully aligned cards and restrained spacing. Use subtle metric text like “销售额”, “订单数”, “访客数”, “转化率”; secondary typography must remain small so charts dominate.
Do not put theme names in the image, no “默认/深蓝/科技/简约” captions, no bottom label ribbon, no selection outline, no watermarks, no logos. Keep exact same chart shapes, approximate data, and panel layout across the series. Image is opaque.
DEFAULT theme: bright clean white cards on #f5f7fa pale cool gray canvas, primary vivid #1677ff blue. Data series colors #1677ff, #36cfc9, #9254de, #fa8c16, #13c2c2, #eb2f96. Airy light mode, blue controls, dark slate typography, delicate gray dividers. This must clearly read as the classic blue enterprise BI theme.
